title: melicope lobocarpa
intro: Melicope lobocarpa, commonly known as Lobocarp Melicope or Yellow Hibiscus, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Melicope lobocarpa include its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent, which can help to combat infections, and its potential to exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also found in other Rutaceae family members.
